description: Get a public URL that records every HTTP request sent to it, plus the inbox_key that all other tools need. Use it as a webhook endpoint, OAuth redirect URI, job callback URL, or with create_approval_link. The key is shown only once: keep it.

ttl_minutes.description: How long the inbox lives (default 1440, allowed 5–10080). It is also deleted after 240 minutes without a tool call using its key. Pick the shortest that covers the task.

name: create_inbox

deleted_if_idle_until.description: When the inbox is deleted if no tool call uses its key before then.

expires_at.description: When the inbox is deleted at the latest.

inbox_key.description: Secret. Pass it to every other Porch tool. Shown only once.

url.description: The public URL. Any sub-path and any HTTP method is accepted.

title: Create inbox
